These insights help identify resource utilization issues and shard imbalances that can cause performance problems, providing visibility into affected resources along with actionable recommendations for remediation.

announcements.title: Oracle Database@AWS is now available in the Dublin AWS Region
announcements.summary: Oracle Database@AWS, which provides Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) managed Oracle Exadata systems within AWS data centers, is now available in the Dublin AWS Region (EU-West-1). This service allows customers to migrate their on-premises Oracle Exadata and Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC) applications to AWS while maintaining a similar environment and integrating with AWS services like AWS Key Management Service.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL supports minor versions 18.3, 17.9, 16.13, 15.17, and 14.22
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL now supports new minor versions 18.3, 17.9, 16.13, 15.17, and 14.22, which address a regression from the February 2026 PostgreSQL community release. AWS recommends upgrading to these latest versions to fix known security vulnerabilities and benefit from bug fixes provided by the PostgreSQL community.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock announces OpenAI-compatible Projects API
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock has added support for OpenAI-compatible Projects API within its Mantle inference engine. This enhancement allows developers to use familiar OpenAI API formats while accessing Bedrock's fully managed service that offers foundation models from companies like Anthropic, Meta, and OpenAI. The integration aims to simplify the development and scaling of generative AI applications through Bedrock's distributed inference capabilities.

announcements.title: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now integrates with Amazon EC2 Capacity Reservations
announcements.summary: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now integrates with Amazon EC2 Capacity Reservations, allowing users to utilize their reserved capacity for predictable workload availability while ECS manages the underlying infrastructure. This integration helps balance reliable capacity scaling with cost efficiency, particularly benefiting mission-critical workloads that require high availability.

announcements.title: AWS Marketplace now supports multiple purchases of SaaS and Professional Services products
announcements.summary: AWS Marketplace now supports Concurrent Agreements, allowing buyers to make multiple purchases of the same SaaS or Professional Services product within a single AWS account. This removes the previous limitation of one active agreement per product per account, eliminating the need for seller workarounds. Different business units can now procure independently with their own customized terms and pricing arrangements.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect now supports dynamic dialing mode switching for outbound campaigns
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now allows contact center administrators to dynamically switch between preview and non-preview dialing modes during active outbound campaigns, eliminating the need to stop and restart campaigns to change strategies. This update replaces the previous rigid system where campaigns were locked into their initial dialing mode once started. The feature enables more flexible and adaptive dialing strategies for outbound campaign management.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch now provides lock contention diagnostics for Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Database Insights now offers lock contention diagnostics for Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL instances, helping users quickly identify root causes of both current and past locking issues. This feature is available exclusively in Advanced mode and provides visualization of blocking relationships in the Database Insights console. The capability enables faster troubleshooting of PostgreSQL database performance problems related to lock contention.

announcements.title: AWS Security Hub launches Extended plan for pay-as-you-go partner solutions
announcements.summary: AWS Security Hub has launched its Extended plan, offering a pay-as-you-go model that combines AWS detection services with curated partner security solutions through a single-vendor experience. This new plan aims to simplify enterprise security operations by reducing the complexity of managing multiple vendor relationships and lengthy procurement cycles. The Extended plan provides streamlined procurement and unified security management across enterprise environments.

announcements.title: Amazon Cognito enhances client secret management with secret rotation and custom secrets
announcements.summary: Amazon Cognito has enhanced client secret management for user pool app clients by introducing client secret rotation capabilities and support for custom client secrets. Previously, Cognito only supported automatically generated client secrets, but this update gives developers more control over secret lifecycle management. These improvements help strengthen security for applications, AI agents, and microservices that authenticate through Cognito.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are available in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in four additional regions: US West (N. California), Europe (Paris), Asia Pacific (Hyderabad), and South America (Sao Paulo). These instances feature custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS and deliver up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generations.

announcements.title: Introducing Amazon EC2 I8g.metal-48xl instances
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 I8g.metal-48xl instances, new storage-optimized instances powered by AWS Graviton4 processors that deliver up to 60% better compute performance than previous I4g instances. These instances feature third-generation AWS Nitro SSDs with local NVMe storage, providing up to 65% better real-time storage performance per TB, 50% lower storage I/O latency, and 60% lower latency variability.

announcements.title: Amazon SNS now supports push notifications in the Europe (Spain) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon SNS now supports push notifications in the AWS Europe (Spain) Region, expanding the fully managed pub/sub service's capabilities to this geographic area. This enables customers in Spain to use Amazon SNS to send push notifications to supported platforms alongside its existing message delivery options to endpoints like Lambda, SQS, HTTP, SMS, and email.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda Durable Execution SDK for Java now available in Developer Preview
announcements.summary: AWS has released a developer preview of the Lambda Durable Execution SDK for Java, which enables developers to build resilient multi-step applications without needing custom progress tracking or external orchestration services. The SDK supports use cases like order processing pipelines, AI workflows, and human-in-the-loop approvals through Lambda durable functions that automatically checkpoint progress.

announcements.title: AWS Outposts racks now support additional Amazon CloudWatch metrics in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: AWS Outposts racks in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions now support two additional Amazon CloudWatch metrics: VifConnectionStatus and VifBgpSessionState. These metrics enable customers to monitor the connectivity status of their Outposts racks' Local Gateway and Service Link Virtual Interfaces directly within the CloudWatch console, eliminating the need for external networking tools.

announcements.title: AWS Security Agent adds support for penetration tests on shared VPCs across AWS accounts
announcements.summary: AWS Security Agent now supports penetration testing on VPC resources that are shared across different AWS accounts within the same organization. This enhancement enables security teams to conduct comprehensive security assessments across multi-account environments from a centralized location. The feature utilizes AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) to securely share VPC resources from sub-accounts to a central AWS account for testing purposes.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL launches Playground for interactive database exploration
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon Aurora DSQL Playground, a browser-based interactive environment that allows developers to explore and experiment with Aurora DSQL without needing an AWS account. The playground enables users to write and execute SQL queries, test schema designs, and experience Aurora DSQL's PostgreSQL-compatible distributed SQL capabilities directly in their browser with no setup required.

announcements.title: Aurora DSQL launches new support for Tortoise, Flyway, and Prisma
announcements.summary: AWS has announced new Aurora DSQL integrations for three popular developer tools: Tortoise (Python ORM), Flyway (schema management), and Prisma (Node.js ORM). These integrations allow developers to use their preferred frameworks with Aurora DSQL while automatically managing IAM authentication and compatibility requirements, making it easier for Python and Node.js developers to work with Aurora DSQL databases.

announcements.title: Aurora DSQL launches new integrations for Visual Studio Code SQLTools and DBeaver
announcements.summary: AWS has launched new integrations for Aurora DSQL with Visual Studio Code SQLTools and DBeaver Community Edition, providing dedicated driver and plugin support for these popular database tools. These integrations enable users to run queries, explore schemas, and manage data in Aurora DSQL clusters while automatically handling IAM authentication and access token management. The new tools eliminate the need for manual token generation code, simplifying database connectivity for developers.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 R8a instances now available in the Europe (Ireland) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 R8a instances are now available in the Europe (Ireland) region, featuring 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors with up to 4.5 GHz frequency. These instances deliver up to 30% higher performance, 19% better price-performance, and 45% more memory bandwidth compared to the previous R7a instances, making them ideal for latency-sensitive workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in Africa (Cape Town) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8i and M8i-flex instances are now available in the Africa (Cape Town) region, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These new instances offer up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances, while delivering up to 20% better performance overall.

announcements.title: Amazon Location Service introduces LLM Context as a Kiro power and Claude Code plugin to improve AI performance
announcements.summary: Amazon Location Service has launched curated AI Agent context that works as a Kiro power, Claude Code plugin, and open Agent Skills format to help developers integrate location services more effectively. This new feature allows developers to use generative AI tools like Kiro, Claude Code, and Cursor to improve code accuracy and accelerate development when adding Amazon Location capabilities to their applications. The enhancement is designed to reduce iteration time and streamline the implementation of geospatial features.

announcements.title: Announcing new metal sizes for Amazon EC2 M8gn and M8gb instances
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of new metal-24xl and metal-48xl sizes for Amazon EC2 M8gn and M8gb instances, powered by AWS Graviton4 processors that deliver up to 30% better compute performance than Graviton3. M8gn instances feature 6th generation AWS Nitro Cards with up to 600 Gbps network bandwidth (the highest among network optimized EC2 instances), while M8gb instances offer up to 300 Gbps of EBS bandwidth.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications extends support for 4K resolution
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications now supports 4K resolution (4096 x 2160) on all non-accelerated instance types and client connection modes, expanding beyond the previous limitation to graphics-accelerated instances only. This enhancement allows customers greater flexibility in choosing appropriate instance types while delivering improved visual quality that matches their existing high-resolution hardware investments.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock now supports server-side tool execution with AgentCore Gateway
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports server-side tool execution through integration with AgentCore Gateway and the Responses API. Customers can connect their AgentCore Gateway tools to Bedrock models by specifying a gateway ARN, eliminating the need for client-side orchestration. This enables automatic tool discovery and presentation to models during execution.

announcements.title: AWS Compute Optimizer now applies AWS-generated tags to EBS snapshots created during automation
announcements.summary: AWS Compute Optimizer now automatically applies AWS-generated tags to EBS snapshots that are created when the service snapshots and deletes unattached EBS volumes. This enhancement improves visibility and tracking by making it easier to identify which snapshots were created through Compute Optimizer's automation processes, whether initiated manually or through automated rules.

announcements.title: AWS Observability now available as a Kiro power
announcements.summary: AWS has launched AWS Observability as a Kiro power, which uses AI agent-assisted workflows to help developers and operators diagnose infrastructure and application health issues more quickly. Kiro Powers is a repository of pre-built Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools validated by partners to streamline specialized software development and deployment scenarios. The AWS Observability power includes four specialized MCP servers designed for targeted observability tasks.

announcements.title: Announcing AWS Elemental Inference
announcements.summary: AWS Elemental Inference is a new fully managed AI service that automatically generates vertical content and highlight clips from live and on-demand video for mobile and social platforms in real time. The service works in parallel with video encoding and enables broadcasters and streamers to reach audiences across multiple formats without requiring AI expertise or dedicated production teams. This allows content creators to efficiently repurpose their video content for different platforms and viewing preferences.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS Snapshot Export to S3 now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS Snapshot Export to S3 is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) regions, allowing users to export database snapshot data in Apache Parquet format for analytics, data retention, and machine learning purposes. The feature supports all snapshot types and runs without impacting database performance, with exported data accessible through AWS analytics services like Amazon Athena.

announcements.title: AWS Deadline Cloud now supports running tasks together in chunks
announcements.summary: AWS Deadline Cloud, a fully managed render management service for 2D/3D graphics and visual effects, now supports grouping tasks into "chunks" for more efficient execution. This new chunking feature is particularly beneficial for short tasks or tasks requiring long startup times, as it reduces overall completion time and costs by running multiple tasks together rather than individually.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 R7a instances are now available in the Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 R7a instances are now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) Region. These instances are powered by 4th Gen AMD EPYC processors and deliver up to 50% higher performance compared to R6a instances, with availability across all purchasing options including On-Demand, Reserved, Spot, and Savings Plans.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 C8i and C8i-flex instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Malaysia) and South America (Sao Paulo) regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 C8i and C8i-flex instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Malaysia) and South America (São Paulo) regions. These instances are powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS, offering up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generations. The new instances deliver the highest performance and fastest memory bandwidth among comparable Intel processors in the cloud.

announcements.title: AWS AppConfig integrates with New Relic for automated rollbacks
announcements.summary: AWS AppConfig has launched a new integration with New Relic Workflow Automation that enables automated rollbacks during feature flag and dynamic configuration deployments. The integration automatically detects degraded application health and triggers rollbacks within seconds, eliminating the need for manual intervention. This builds on AWS AppConfig's existing third-party alert capabilities to provide New Relic users with intelligent, automated deployment protection.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8a instances now available in AWS Europe (Frankfurt) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8a instances are now available in the AWS Europe (Frankfurt) region, powered by 5th generation AMD EPYC processors with frequencies up to 4.5 GHz. These new instances offer up to 30% higher performance, 19% better price-performance, and 45% more memory bandwidth compared to the previous M7a instances, making them well-suited for latency-sensitive workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon EKS Node Monitoring Agent is now open source
announcements.summary: Amazon EKS has open-sourced its Node Monitoring Agent, making the source code available on GitHub for community contributions. The agent addresses the challenge of maintaining reliable Kubernetes workloads by automatically monitoring and managing degraded cluster nodes, eliminating the need for manual intervention by cluster administrators.

announcements.title: MediaConvert Introduces new video probe API and UI
announcements.summary: AWS Elemental MediaConvert has launched a new Probe API, a free metadata analysis tool that quickly extracts essential information about media files including codec specifications, pixel formats, color space details, and container information by reading header metadata. The tool is designed for efficiency, providing this analysis without needing to process the actual video content. This makes it particularly valuable for content creators, developers, and media professionals who need rapid media file insights.

announcements.title: AWS Trusted Advisor now delivers more accurate unused NAT Gateway checks powered by AWS Compute Optimizer
announcements.summary: AWS Trusted Advisor has improved its unused NAT Gateway detection by integrating AWS Compute Optimizer capabilities, which analyze additional CloudWatch metrics over a 32-day period and verify route table associations. This enhancement significantly reduces false positives by avoiding flagging critical backup resources, enabling cost optimization teams and DevOps engineers to more confidently identify and remove truly unused NAT Gateways that generate unnecessary charges.

announcements.title: Amazon announces generative AI-based artifacts in Amazon Q Developer for visualizing resource and cost data
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon Q Developer artifacts, a generative AI feature that allows customers to visualize AWS resource data in tables and cost data in charts directly within the AWS Management Console. The update also relocates the Q icon to the navigation bar and moves the chat panel to the left side for easier access throughout the console. Customers can access these AI-powered visualization tools by clicking the Amazon Q icon and making requests.

announcements.title: AWS IAM Policy Autopilot is now available as a Kiro Power
announcements.summary: AWS has released IAM Policy Autopilot as a Kiro power, making the open source static code analysis tool available for agentic AI development with one-click installation. The tool automatically generates baseline AWS IAM policies for developers, eliminating manual policy creation and allowing policies to be refined as applications evolve. This integration brings IAM policy expertise directly into the Kiro IDE and web interface.

announcements.title: AWS Elemental Media Services Now Available in Asia Pacific (Malaysia) Region
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded its Elemental Media Services suite to the Asia Pacific (Malaysia) Region, bringing cloud-based video workflow capabilities closer to Southeast Asian audiences. The comprehensive suite includes MediaConnect, MediaLive, MediaPackage, MediaConvert, and MediaTailor, enabling businesses to ingest, transport, transcode, package, and deliver high-quality video content with reduced latency and better performance for viewers in Malaysia and the broader Southeast Asian region.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift Serverless introduces 3-year Serverless Reservations
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift Serverless now offers 3-year Serverless Reservations that provide up to 45% cost savings and improved cost predictability for analytics workloads. Customers can commit to a specific number of Redshift Processing Units (RPUs) for three years with no upfront payment required. This new pricing option enhances the serverless analytics platform that automatically scales without requiring cluster provisioning or management.

announcements.title: Amazon S3 Tables are now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon S3 Tables, AWS's first cloud object store with built-in Apache Iceberg support, are now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East) and (US-West) regions. This service provides optimized tabular data storage at scale with automatic table maintenance that continuously optimizes query performance and storage costs as data lakes grow. S3 Tables support the Apache Iceberg standard, enabling easy querying of tabular data.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports January 2026 Release Update and Spatial Patch Bundle
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports the January 2026 Release Update for Oracle Database versions 19c and 21c, which includes important security updates. Additionally, Oracle Database 19c receives the corresponding Spatial Patch Bundle that provides fixes for Oracle Spatial and Graph functionality. AWS recommends upgrading to the January 2026 RU to ensure security and optimal performance.

announcements.title: AWS IAM Identity Center is now available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) AWS Region
announcements.summary: AWS IAM Identity Center is now available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) region, expanding availability to 38 total AWS regions. This service provides single sign-on capabilities for workforce access to AWS applications by connecting existing identity sources, and powers personalized experiences in AWS applications like Amazon Q while enabling user-aware access control and auditing.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 G7e instances now available in Asia Pacific (Tokyo) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 G7e instances, powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, are now available in the Asia Pacific (Tokyo) region. These instances deliver up to 2.3x better inference performance compared to G6e instances and are optimized for deploying large language models, agentic AI, multimodal generative AI, and physical AI models. G7e instances provide the highest performance for spatial computing and graphics-intensive workloads.

announcements.title: Aurora DSQL launches new Go, Python, and Node.js connectors that simplify IAM authentication
announcements.summary: AWS has launched new Aurora DSQL Connectors for Go, Python, and Node.js that simplify IAM authentication when connecting to Aurora DSQL clusters using standard PostgreSQL drivers. These connectors automatically handle IAM token generation and act as transparent authentication layers, eliminating the need for developers to manually write token generation code or supply IAM tokens.

announcements.title: Amazon MQ now supports ActiveMQ minor version 5.19
announcements.summary: Amazon MQ now supports ActiveMQ minor version 5.19, which includes various improvements and fixes over previous versions. The service automatically manages patch version upgrades during scheduled maintenance windows for brokers running version 5.19. AWS strongly recommends users upgrade from earlier ActiveMQ versions like 5.18 to take advantage of the latest enhancements.

announcements.title: Amazon SNS now supports sending SMS in additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon SNS has expanded SMS messaging capabilities to the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) and Asia Pacific (Taipei) regions, allowing customers to send text messages to subscribers in over 200 countries and territories. This enhancement extends SNS's fully managed pub/sub messaging service, which already supports multiple endpoints including AWS Lambda, Amazon SQS, and mobile devices, to include SMS functionality in these additional regions.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8i-flex instances are now available in additional AWS regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8i-flex instances are now available in six additional AWS regions across Asia Pacific, Europe, and Canada. These instances are powered by exclusive custom Intel Xeon 6 processors that deliver up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances.

announcements.title: AWS Certificate Manager updates default certificate validity to comply with new guidelines
announcements.summary: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) has reduced the maximum validity period for public certificates from 395 days to 198 days, effective immediately. This change ensures compliance with the new Certification Authority Browser Forum mandate requiring certificates to be no longer than 200 days, which takes effect March 15, 2026. No customer action is required, as all new and renewed public certificates will automatically use the shorter validity period.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now integrates with Kiro powers and AI agent skills
announcements.summary: AWS has announced that Amazon Aurora DSQL now integrates with Kiro powers and AI agent skills, allowing developers to build Aurora DSQL-backed applications more quickly through AI-assisted development. The integration includes a bundled Aurora DSQL Model Context Protocol (MCP) server with development best practices, enabling AI agents to assist with database schema design, performance optimization, and operations out of the box.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Cases now supports AWS Service Quotas
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Cases now integrates with AWS Service Quotas, allowing administrators to centrally monitor limits and usage while scaling case workloads more effectively. Administrators can request quota increases directly through the Service Quotas console, with eligible requests receiving automatic approval. This enhancement helps prevent service disruptions from unexpected quota constraints.

announcements.title: Amazon Managed Grafana now supports AWS KMS customer managed keys
announcements.summary: Amazon Managed Grafana now supports AWS KMS customer managed keys (CMK), allowing users to encrypt data in their Grafana workspaces using their own encryption keys instead of the default AWS owned keys. This enhancement provides greater control over data encryption for the fully managed Grafana service that helps visualize and analyze operational data at scale.

announcements.title: AWS Clean Rooms announces support for remote Apache Iceberg REST catalogs
announcements.summary: AWS Clean Rooms now supports catalog federation for remote Apache Iceberg REST catalogs, allowing direct and secure access to Iceberg tables stored in Amazon S3 without requiring table metadata replication. This new capability simplifies clean room setup by enabling organizations to use AWS Glue catalog federation to connect their existing Iceberg REST catalogs directly in Clean Rooms collaborations.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service expands support for Graviton4 (c8g,m8g & r8g ) instances
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports AWS Graviton4-based EC2 instances, including compute optimized (c8g), general purpose (m8g), and memory optimized (r8g, r8gd) instance types. These new Graviton4 processors deliver up to 30% better performance compared to Graviton3 processors while offering the best price-performance ratio for their respective workload types.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports storage optimized  i7i  instances
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports the latest generation i7i storage optimized instances powered by 5th generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors. These new instances deliver up to 23% better compute performance and over 10% better price performance compared to previous generation i4i instances. The i7i instances feature 3rd generation AWS Nitro SSDs that provide up to 50% better real-time storage performance and significantly lower storage I/O latency.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 R8i and R8i-flex instances are now available in Europe (Ireland) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 R8i and R8i-flex instances are now available in the Europe (Ireland) region, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These new instances provide up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances, delivering the highest performance among comparable Intel processors in the cloud.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock reinforcement fine-tuning adds support for open-weight models with OpenAI-compatible APIs
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock has expanded its reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) capabilities to support popular open-weight models like OpenAI GPT-OSS and Qwen, while adding OpenAI-compatible fine-tuning APIs. This enhancement allows developers to improve model accuracy without needing extensive machine learning expertise or large datasets, as the service automates the entire customization workflow and enables models to learn from feedback.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora MySQL 3.12 (compatible with MySQL 8.0.44) is now generally available
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora MySQL 3.12, which is compatible with MySQL 8.0.44, is now generally available. This release includes security enhancements, bug fixes, and several availability improvements. Users can upgrade manually by modifying their DB cluster or enable automatic minor version upgrades.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect now includes agent time-off requests in draft schedules
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now automatically includes agent time-off requests when generating draft schedules, providing clear visibility into why agents aren't scheduled for specific days or periods. This enhancement eliminates the need for schedulers to check published schedules or troubleshoot configurations to understand scheduling gaps. The feature helps streamline workforce management by making time-off information readily visible during the schedule planning process.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 C8a instances now available in the Europe (Frankfurt) and Europe (Ireland) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 C8a instances, powered by 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors, are now available in the Europe (Frankfurt) and Europe (Ireland) regions. These compute-optimized instances deliver up to 30% higher performance and 19% better price-performance compared to C7a instances, with 33% more memory bandwidth making them ideal for latency-sensitive workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect now supports multi-line text fields on case templates
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now supports multi-line text fields on case templates, enabling agents to capture detailed notes and structured data with expanded vertical space for multiple paragraphs. These enhanced fields are designed to better accommodate comprehensive documentation such as root cause analysis, transaction details, and investigation findings. The feature is available through Amazon Connect Cases in multiple AWS regions including US East, US West, Canada Central, and Europe.

announcements.title: Amazon MSK now supports dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6) connectivity for existing clusters
announcements.summary: Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) now supports dual-stack connectivity, allowing both IPv4 and IPv6 protocols for existing MSK Provisioned and MSK Serverless clusters. This enhancement enables customers to modernize their applications for IPv6 environments while maintaining backward compatibility with IPv4. The feature helps organizations meet compliance requirements and prepare for future network architecture changes.

announcements.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 now available in Amazon Bedrock
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports Claude Sonnet 4.6, Anthropic's latest AI model that delivers frontier performance in coding, agents, and professional work while approaching Opus 4.6 intelligence at a lower cost. The model excels at computer use tasks, enabling organizations to deploy browser-based automation across business tools with near-human reliability. This makes it ideal for high-volume coding and knowledge work that requires faster, high-quality task completion.

announcements.title: AWS HealthImaging launches additional metrics for monitoring data stores
announcements.summary: AWS HealthImaging has launched new CloudWatch metrics that allow customers to monitor medical imaging storage at both account and data store levels. The metrics provide granular tracking of storage volume, image sets, and DICOM studies, series, and instances. This enhancement helps customers better understand their medical imaging storage usage and growth patterns over time.

announcements.title: Announcing new high performance computing Amazon EC2 Hpc8a instances
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 Hpc8a instances, a new generation of high-performance computing instances powered by 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors with frequencies up to 4.5GHz. These instances deliver up to 40% higher performance and 25% better price performance compared to the previous Hpc7a generation, built on sixth-generation AWS Nitro Cards. The new instances are designed to accelerate compute-intensive workloads while providing better cost optimization for customers.

announcements.title: Announcing Amazon DocumentDB long-term support (LTS) on 5.0
announcements.summary: Amazon DocumentDB now offers Long-Term Support (LTS) for version 5.0, allowing customers to reduce database upgrade frequency and maintenance overhead. LTS versions will only receive critical stability and security patches without new features, helping organizations maintain stable database environments with less frequent updates.

announcements.title: AWS Backup announces PrivateLink support for SAP HANA on AWS
announcements.summary: AWS Backup now supports AWS PrivateLink for SAP HANA systems on Amazon EC2, allowing backup traffic to flow through private network connections instead of the public internet. This enhancement helps organizations in regulated industries like financial services, healthcare, and government meet strict security and compliance requirements for their SAP HANA workloads.

announcements.title: AWS Glue 5.1 is now available in 18 additional regions
announcements.summary: AWS Glue 5.1 is now available in 18 additional regions across Africa, Asia Pacific, Canada, Europe, Israel, Mexico, Middle East, and the US West. This expansion significantly increases global availability of AWS's serverless data integration service, which helps organizations discover, prepare, and integrate data from multiple sources.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M7i instances are now available in the Israel (Tel Aviv) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M7i instances, powered by custom 4th generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors (Sapphire Rapids), are now available in the Israel (Tel Aviv) region. These AWS-exclusive processors deliver up to 15% better performance than comparable Intel processors used by other cloud providers and offer up to 15% better price-performance compared to the previous generation M6i instances.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora now supports Server-Side Encryption at Rest
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora now automatically applies server-side encryption at rest to all new database clusters by default using AWS-owned keys, with no additional cost or performance impact. This enhancement strengthens security posture while remaining fully managed and transparent to users. Existing database clusters are not affected by this change and will continue operating with their current encryption settings.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 supports nested virtualization on virtual Amazon EC2 instances
announcements.summary: AWS now supports nested virtualization on virtual Amazon EC2 instances, allowing customers to run virtual machines within virtual machines using KVM or Hyper-V hypervisors. Previously, this capability was only available on bare metal EC2 instances. This enhancement enables use cases like mobile app emulation, automotive hardware simulation, and running Windows Subsystem for Linux within virtualized environments.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i instances now available in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon has expanded the regional availability of its EC2 High Memory U7i instances, bringing 6TB instances to South America (São Paulo) and Europe (Milan), 12TB instances to AWS GovCloud (US-East), and 16TB instances to Europe (London). These 7th generation instances are powered by custom Intel Xeon Scalable Processors (Sapphire Rapids) and feature DDR5 memory ranging from 6TiB to 16TiB depending on the instance type.

announcements.title: AWS Batch now provides Job Queue and Share Utilization Visibility
announcements.summary: AWS Batch has introduced new visibility features that provide insights into queue and share utilization, showing how workloads are distributed across compute resources. The update includes queue utilization data in job queue snapshots for both FIFO and fair share queues, plus individual fair share allocation capacity consumption details. The ListServiceJobs API has also been enhanced with a scheduledAt timestamp for better job tracking.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect launches in-app notifications to surface critical operational alerts to business users
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has introduced in-app notifications that appear in the workspace header across all pages, allowing teams to stay informed of critical operational alerts without disrupting their current workflow. The feature includes a notification icon with an unread message badge, and users can view messages, access embedded links, and manage read/unread status directly from the header without leaving their current task.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect now provides real time AI-powered overviews and recommended next actions for Tasks
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has launched a new AI-powered feature that automatically generates task overviews and suggests next actions to help agents process work items more efficiently. The system summarizes previous activities (like order verification or eligibility checks) and provides recommended steps to complete tasks such as processing refunds. This enhancement is designed to help customer service agents understand context faster and resolve issues more quickly.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS now supports backup configuration when restoring snapshots
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS and Aurora now allow users to view and modify backup settings (retention period and backup window) when restoring database snapshots, providing greater flexibility during restore operations. Previously, restored databases automatically inherited backup configurations from the original snapshot without the ability to customize these settings. This enhancement gives users more control over their backup policies immediately upon restoration.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL adds support for identity columns and sequence objects
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports identity columns and sequence objects, allowing developers to generate auto-incrementing integer IDs directly in the database using standard SQL patterns. This feature simplifies PostgreSQL application migrations and enables creation of compact, human-readable identifiers like order numbers and account IDs without requiring custom ID generation logic.

announcements.title: Announcing Amazon EC2 C8i, M8i, and R8i instances on second-generation AWS Outposts racks
announcements.summary: AWS has launched its latest generation of EC2 instances (C8i, M8i, and R8i) on second-generation AWS Outposts racks, offering compute-optimized, general-purpose, and memory-optimized configurations respectively. These new x86-powered instances deliver 20% better performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to their predecessors (C7i, M7i, and R7i instances) on the same Outposts infrastructure.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock adds support for the latest open-weight models in Asia Pacific (Sydney)
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock has expanded support for the latest open-weight foundation models to the Asia Pacific (Sydney) region through the bedrock-mantle endpoint. The newly supported models come from major AI providers including DeepSeek, Google, MiniMax, Mistral, Moonshot AI, Nvidia, and OpenAI. This expansion gives customers in the Sydney region access to more diverse AI models through AWS's fully managed generative AI service.

announcements.title: Amazon S3 Access Grants are now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon S3 Access Grants is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Taipei) Region. This feature allows you to map identities from directories like Microsoft Entra ID or AWS IAM principals to S3 datasets, enabling automatic access management based on corporate identity. It helps organizations manage data permissions at scale by streamlining S3 access for end users.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock expands support for AWS PrivateLink
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock, AWS's fully managed service for accessing foundation models and building generative AI applications, has expanded its AWS PrivateLink support to include the bedrock-mantle endpoint. This addition allows customers to privately access their applications through the new endpoint, which is powered by Project Mantle, complementing the existing PrivateLink support for the bedrock-runtime endpoint.

announcements.title: AWS expands Resource Control Policies support to Amazon DynamoDB
announcements.summary: AWS has extended Resource Control Policies (RCPs) support to Amazon DynamoDB, allowing organizations to centrally manage and limit the maximum permissions for DynamoDB resources. This enhancement enables administrators to create policies that restrict access to DynamoDB from identities outside their organization, helping to establish stronger data perimeter controls.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock increases default quotas for Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 4.5 model in AWS GovCloud (US)
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock has increased the default quotas for Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 4.5 model in AWS GovCloud regions by 25x, raising limits to 5,000,000 tokens per minute and 1,000 requests per minute to match commercial AWS regions. This enhancement allows customers in regulated environments to better scale their AI workloads using Claude Sonnet 4.5, which is optimized for complex agents, coding, and long-horizon tasks.

announcements.title: AI Troubleshooting in the AWS Support Center Console now supports 7 additional languages
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded AI troubleshooting capabilities in the AWS Support Center Console to support seven additional languages beyond English: Japanese, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Mandarin, Spanish, Portuguese, and French. This update removes language barriers that previously existed when the feature was only available in English, allowing customers to access AI-powered support assistance in their preferred language. The AWS Support Center Console serves as the main platform where customers manage their support experience and track support cases.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL supports minor versions  18.2, 17.8, 16.12, 15.16 and 14.21
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL now supports minor versions 18.2, 17.8, 16.12, 15.16, and 14.21, which include security vulnerability fixes and bug fixes from the PostgreSQL community. The release also introduces the new pg_stat_monitor extension that provides unified performance metrics and query performance insights. AWS recommends upgrading to these latest minor versions for improved security and functionality.

announcements.title: Announcing new Amazon EC2 general purpose M8azn instances
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon EC2 M8azn instances, which are general purpose instances powered by fifth generation AMD EPYC processors with the highest maximum CPU frequency of 5GHz in the cloud. These new instances offer up to 2x compute performance compared to previous generation M5zn instances and up to 24% higher performance than M8a instances, while also delivering significantly improved memory bandwidth.

announcements.title: Amazon S3 Tables add partition and sort order definition in the CreateTable API
announcements.summary: Amazon S3 Tables now supports defining partition and sort order properties directly in the CreateTable API, simplifying programmatic table management and optimization. This enhancement allows developers to specify these properties when creating tables through the API, AWS CLI, or AWS SDK, eliminating the need for separate configuration steps after table creation.

announcements.title: AWS Backup adds cross-Region database snapshot copy to logically air-gapped vaults
announcements.summary: AWS Backup now enables direct cross-Region database snapshot copying to logically air-gapped vaults for Amazon Aurora, Neptune, and DocumentDB, eliminating the need for intermediate copying steps. This single-action capability helps protect against ransomware attacks and regional outages by allowing cross-Region and cross-account snapshot copies directly to secure, isolated storage locations.

announcements.title: AWS Payment Cryptography Achieves Cartes Bancaires Approval
announcements.summary: AWS Payment Cryptography has received approval from Groupement des Cartes Bancaires (CB), France's national card payment network, making it one of the first cloud-based payment cryptography services to achieve this certification. This approval allows payment organizations like banks, processors, and payment facilitators to run their payment workloads on AWS while maintaining CB compliance requirements.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect launches after contact work timeout configuration for tasks, chats, and emails
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now allows administrators to configure after contact work timeout settings for agents handling chats, tasks, emails, and callbacks. This feature automatically returns agents to a ready state after a specified time limit, preventing them from spending too long on post-contact activities and improving overall efficiency. The timeout settings can be customized at the channel level for each agent to optimize workflow management.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect launches auto-accept for tasks, chats, and emails
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has expanded its auto-accept functionality beyond inbound voice contacts to now include chats, tasks, emails, and callbacks. This feature automatically connects incoming contacts to available agents without requiring manual acceptance, reducing wait times and ensuring customers receive faster assistance. The auto-accept settings can be configured at the channel level for individual agents.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now available in additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora DSQL, AWS's fastest serverless distributed SQL database, has expanded availability to four new regions: Asia Pacific (Melbourne and Sydney) and Canada (Central and West Calgary). The service offers virtually unlimited scalability, high availability, and zero infrastructure management for building always-available applications. Aurora DSQL is designed to provide effortless scaling and resilience with single-Region cluster support in these newly added locations.

announcements.title: Amazon MSK now supports broker logs on Express Brokers
announcements.summary: Amazon MSK now provides broker logs for Express Brokers at no additional cost, enabling users to troubleshoot connectivity and availability issues while gaining insights into broker behavior during rebalances or fail-overs. The logs can be easily integrated into existing observability pipelines through pre-built connections with Amazon CloudWatch Logs and Amazon S3. This feature is available for both new and existing MSK Express clusters.

announcements.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk now supports GitHub Actions for automated application deployment
announcements.summary: AWS Elastic Beanstalk now integrates with GitHub Actions to enable automated deployment of web applications directly from GitHub repositories. This integration streamlines CI/CD pipelines by automatically deploying applications when code or configuration changes are pushed to the repository. The feature helps development teams automate their software delivery process with built-in build, test, and deployment workflows.

announcements.title: AWS Lake Formation enhances cross-account sharing
announcements.summary: AWS Lake Formation now supports enhanced cross-account sharing, enabling organizations to share hundreds of thousands of tables across multiple AWS accounts. The service allows centralized permission management for catalogs, databases, and tables, with fine-grained access controls that can be shared with external IAM principals, AWS accounts, AWS Organizations, and organizational units (OUs).

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 C8i and C8i-flex instances are now available in Europe (Paris), Canada (Central), and US West (N. California) regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 C8i and C8i-flex instances are now available in three additional regions: Europe (Paris), Canada (Central), and US West (N. California). These instances are powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS, offering up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generations.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for MariaDB now supports community MariaDB minor versions 10.6.25, 10.11.16, 11.4.10, and 11.8.6
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for MariaDB now supports four new community minor versions: 10.6.25, 10.11.16, 11.4.10, and 11.8.6. AWS recommends upgrading to these latest versions to address security vulnerabilities and benefit from bug fixes, performance improvements, and new features. Users can utilize automatic minor version upgrades to keep their databases updated.

announcements.title: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) is Now Available in the Asia Pacific (Melbourne) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) has expanded its availability to the Asia Pacific (Melbourne) region. This fully managed JSON database service allows users to operate critical document workloads at scale without infrastructure management, specifically designed for mission-critical MongoDB workloads with enhanced scalability and durability.

announcements.title: Amazon Neptune Analytics is now available in 7 additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Neptune Analytics has expanded to 7 new regions including Middle East (Bahrain and UAE), Israel (Tel Aviv), Africa (Cape Town), Canada (Calgary), Asia Pacific (Malaysia), and Europe (Zurich). Users can now create and manage Neptune Analytics graphs in these regions to run advanced graph analytics. Neptune is a serverless graph database that enhances AI application accuracy while reducing operational costs and instantly scaling graph workloads.

announcements.title: AWS HealthOmics introduces a Kiro Power and Kiro IDE extension for bioinformatics workflow development
announcements.summary: AWS HealthOmics has launched a Kiro Power and Kiro IDE extension that enables faster bioinformatics workflow development through AI agent-assisted tools. The extension allows users to create, run, debug, and optimize HealthOmics workflows in domain-specific languages like Nextflow and WDL directly within the Kiro interface. This integration enhances AWS HealthOmics' HIPAA-eligible platform for accelerating scientific breakthroughs through managed bioinformatics workflows.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift now supports allocating extra compute for automatic optimizations
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift now allows database administrators to allocate additional compute resources specifically for automatic optimization features (autonomics) during high-activity periods. This eliminates the need to manually schedule optimizations like Automatic Table Optimization, Automatic Table Sorting, Auto Vacuum, and Auto Analyze, allowing these processes to run continuously without impacting user workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Secure Browser now supports custom domain
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces Secure Browser now allows organizations to use custom domains for their portal access instead of the default AWS-provided URLs. This enhancement enables administrators to configure portal access through their own domain names, providing a more branded and integrated user experience. The setup requires adding the custom domain in the portal settings and configuring a reverse proxy.

announcements.title: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud
announcements.summary: Amazon ECS Managed Instances is now available in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, providing a fully managed compute option that eliminates infrastructure management overhead while maintaining access to full EC2 capabilities. This service automatically handles infrastructure operations and scaling, allowing organizations to focus on applications while reducing total cost of ownership and operational complexity.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser now supports browser profiles
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser now supports browser profiles, allowing users to maintain authentication state across multiple browser sessions without needing to log in repeatedly. This feature significantly reduces session setup time from minutes to tens of seconds by persisting browser data like cookies and local storage. The enhancement particularly benefits enterprise customers who run hundreds or thousands of automated browser sessions daily.

announcements.title: AWS Config now supports 30 new resource types
announcements.summary: AWS Config has added support for 30 new resource types across services including Amazon EKS, Amazon Q, and AWS IoT, expanding monitoring coverage of AWS environments. This enhancement allows users to better discover, assess, audit, and remediate a broader range of resources. If you have recording enabled for all resource types, AWS Config will automatically begin tracking these new additions.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Cases now supports CSV uploads to map related field options
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Cases now allows administrators to use CSV file uploads to define complex field relationships in case templates, such as which defect types apply to specific product categories. This new feature replaces manual configuration with bulk uploads, significantly reducing setup time and onboarding effort for organizations managing large-scale field option mappings.

announcements.title: AWS Network Firewall announces new price reductions
announcements.summary: AWS Network Firewall has announced two key pricing reductions to lower costs for customers. The service now extends existing hourly and data processing discounts to NAT Gateways that are service-chained with Network Firewall secondary endpoints, expanding beyond the previous limitation to primary endpoints only. Additionally, AWS has eliminated extra data processing charges for Advanced Inspection features, including TLS inspection of encrypted traffic.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 G6e instances now available in Dubai region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 G6e instances powered by NVIDIA L40S Tensor Core GPUs are now available in the Middle East (UAE) Region in Dubai. These instances support machine learning and spatial computing applications, including deployment of large language models, diffusion models for generating images/video/audio, and creating immersive 3D simulations and digital twins.

announcements.title: AWS Builder ID now supports Sign in with Apple
announcements.summary: AWS Builder ID has added Sign in with Apple as a new social login option, joining the existing Sign in with Google capability. This allows Apple users to access AWS applications like AWS Builder Center, Training and Certification, re:Post, Startups, and Kiro using their Apple credentials instead of managing separate AWS login information.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces launches Graphics G6, Gr6, and G6f bundles
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces has launched 12 new Graphics bundles (G6, Gr6, and G6f) built on the EC2 G6 family, designed to support graphics-intensive and GPU-accelerated workloads. These bundles are available on both WorkSpaces Personal and Core, offering various performance, memory, and cost configurations to meet different customer requirements.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 I7ie instances now available in AWS Canada (Central)
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 I7ie instances are now available in AWS Canada (Central), designed for large storage I/O intensive workloads with 5th Gen Intel Xeon Processors running at 3.2 GHz all-core turbo frequency. These instances deliver up to 40% better compute performance and 20% better price performance compared to I3en instances, while offering up to 120TB of local NVMe storage density—the highest available in the cloud for storage-optimized instances.

announcements.title: AWS Glue launches native REST API connector for universal data integration
announcements.summary: AWS Glue has launched a native REST API connector that allows customers to easily integrate data from any REST-enabled source into their ETL workflows. This new capability enables users to create custom connectors for REST-based data sources and seamlessly incorporate them into AWS Glue ETL jobs. The addition expands AWS Glue's connectivity options beyond its existing 60+ native connectors for 100+ non-AWS data sources.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i-6TB instances now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 High Memory U7i-6TB instances (u7i-6tb.112xlarge) are now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West), featuring 6TiB of DDR5 memory and 448 vCPUs powered by custom fourth-generation Intel Xeon Scalable Processors. These 7th generation instances are designed to scale transaction processing throughput in fast-growing data environments and support up to 100Gbps Elastic Block Storage.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 capacity blocks for ML can be shared across multiple accounts
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of cross-account sharing for Amazon EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML, enabling organizations to share reserved GPU capacity across multiple AWS accounts through AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM). This feature allows organizations to purchase Capacity Blocks once and provision them across different accounts and workloads at no additional cost, helping optimize GPU utilization and reduce overall expenses.

announcements.title: Claude Opus 4.6 now available in Amazon Bedrock
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports Claude Opus 4.6, which Anthropic describes as their most intelligent model and the world's best for coding, enterprise agents, and professional work. The model brings advanced capabilities to Bedrock customers, offering industry-leading performance for complex coding projects, agentic tasks, and enterprise workflows that require deep reasoning and reliability.

announcements.title: AWS Batch now supports unmanaged compute environments for Amazon EKS
announcements.summary: AWS Batch now supports unmanaged compute environments for Amazon EKS, allowing users to leverage AWS Batch's job scheduling and orchestration capabilities while maintaining full control over their Kubernetes infrastructure. This feature is particularly beneficial for organizations with specific security, compliance, or operational requirements that need direct management of their EKS clusters. Users can create these environments through the CreateComputeEnvironment API or AWS Batch console by selecting their existing EKS cluster.

announcements.title: Structured outputs now available in Amazon Bedrock
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports structured outputs, allowing foundation models to generate consistent, machine-readable responses that automatically adhere to predefined JSON schemas. This eliminates the need for manual JSON validation and additional application checks, making production workflows more reliable and predictable. The feature is particularly useful for tasks like data extraction and automated workflow processes.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 G7e instances now available in US West (Oregon) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 G7e instances powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs are now available in the US West (Oregon) region. These instances deliver up to 2.3x better inference performance compared to G6e instances and are optimized for deploying large language models, agentic AI, multimodal generative AI, and physical AI models. G7e instances provide the highest performance for spatial computing and hybrid graphics workloads.

announcements.title: Cartesia Sonic 3 text-to-speech model is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
announcements.summary: Cartesia's Sonic 3, a state-of-the-art text-to-speech model, is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, offering AWS customers access to high-quality speech synthesis with industry-leading low latency. The model supports 42 languages and provides fine-grained control over speech characteristics including volume, speed, and emotion through API parameters and SSML tags.

announcements.title: Amazon ECS adds Network Load Balancer support for Linear and Canary deployments
announcements.summary: Amazon ECS now natively supports linear and canary deployment strategies for services using Network Load Balancers (NLB), enabling managed incremental traffic shifting during updates. This feature particularly benefits applications requiring TCP/UDP connections, low latency, long-lived connections, or static IP addresses. ECS customers using NLB can now perform controlled traffic shifting for safer application rollouts.

announcements.title: Apache Spark lineage now available in Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio for IDC based domains
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker has made Data Lineage for Apache Spark jobs generally available in SageMaker Unified Studio for IDC-based domains. This feature tracks schema and data transformations across EMR (EC2, Serverless, EKS) and AWS Glue environments, helping users identify root causes of issues and understand the impact of data changes.

announcements.title: Introducing Amazon EC2 C8id, M8id, and R8id instances
announcements.summary: AWS has launched new Amazon EC2 C8id, M8id, and R8id instances powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors, delivering up to 43% higher performance and 3.3x more memory bandwidth than previous generation instances. These new instances offer significantly expanded capacity with up to 384 vCPUs, 3TiB of memory, and 22.8TB of NVMe SSD storage—three times more than their predecessors.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 and VPC now display related resources for security groups
announcements.summary: AWS has launched a new "Related resources" tab for security groups in the Amazon EC2 and VPC consoles, providing users with a consolidated view of all resources that depend on a specific security group. This feature eliminates the need to manually check multiple services before making security group configuration changes, helping customers better understand dependencies and avoid potential issues when modifying their virtual firewall rules.

announcements.title: Amazon EKS simplifies providing IAM permissions to EKS add-ons in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EKS has introduced direct integration between EKS add-ons and EKS Pod Identity in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, simplifying how cluster operational software obtains IAM permissions to interact with AWS services. This integration streamlines the lifecycle management process for critical add-ons that need to access AWS resources outside the Kubernetes cluster.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift now supports autonomics for multi-cluster environments
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift has extended its autonomics capabilities to support multi-cluster environments, allowing automatic optimization features to work intelligently across multiple warehouses. This enhancement eliminates the need for manual performance tuning across consumer clusters, benefiting database administrators who manage distributed Redshift workloads. The autonomics features include Automatic Table Optimization, Automatic Table Sorting, Auto Vacuum, and Auto Analyze.

announcements.title: Amazon DynamoDB global tables now support replication across multiple AWS accounts
announcements.summary: Amazon DynamoDB global tables now support replication across multiple AWS accounts, allowing customers to replicate tables across both accounts and regions. This new capability enables improved resiliency, account-level workload isolation, and the ability to apply distinct security and governance controls across different AWS accounts.

announcements.title: AWS Marketplace introduces localized billing for Professional Services from AWS EMEA
announcements.summary: AWS Marketplace has launched localized billing for Professional Services in the Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) region through the AWS EMEA Marketplace Operator. EMEA customers can now use local payment methods and receive invoices directly from AWS EMEA, eliminating previous procurement barriers caused by complex cross-entity payment processes. This change simplifies the purchasing experience for Professional Services in the EMEA region.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS now provides an enhanced console experience to connect to a database
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS has launched an enhanced console experience that consolidates all database connection information in one centralized location. The new interface provides ready-made, automatically-configured code snippets for multiple programming languages (Java, Python, Node.js) and command-line tools like psql, with snippets that adjust based on your database's specific authentication settings.

announcements.title: AWS Lake Formation is now available in Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
announcements.summary: AWS Lake Formation has expanded to the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region, allowing organizations in that area to centrally manage fine-grained data access permissions and securely share data. The service enables users to define data locations and security policies while providing access to a centralized AWS Glue Data Catalog that describes available datasets and their usage guidelines.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect launches an appeals workflow for agent performance evaluations
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has introduced an integrated appeals workflow that allows agents to dispute performance evaluations directly within the Connect UI. When agents disagree with their evaluation scores, they can submit appeals with supporting reasoning, such as citing specific examples of good performance that may have been overlooked. This feature aims to improve evaluation fairness and boost agent engagement in the performance review process.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports indexes on the NUMERIC data type
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora DSQL has added support for creating indexes on NUMERIC data types, allowing NUMERIC columns to be used in both primary keys and secondary indexes. This enhancement improves query performance for applications that work with high-precision numerical data like currency amounts, measurements, and statistical information.

announcements.title: AWS Management Console now displays Account Name on the Navigation bar for easier account identification
announcements.summary: AWS has made the account name visible in the AWS Management Console's navigation bar across all public regions, making it easier for users to identify which account they're currently working in. This feature helps customers who manage multiple AWS accounts (such as separate development and production environments) quickly distinguish between accounts at a glance. The account name is displayed for all authorized users within each account.

announcements.title: AWS IAM Identity Center enables account access and application use in multiple AWS Regions
announcements.summary: AWS IAM Identity Center now allows you to replicate your single sign-on configuration from your primary AWS Region to additional regions of your choice. This enhancement improves resilience for user access to AWS accounts and enables you to deploy applications in regions that better meet your business requirements, such as data residency and user proximity needs.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick Suite Enables Easy Resolution of Ambiguous Map Locations
announcements.summary: Amazon QuickSight (part of AWS analytics services) has introduced a new feature that allows users to resolve ambiguous map locations directly within map visualizations. When location names appear in multiple regions—like "Springfield" which exists in several U.S. states—users can now explicitly define the correct geographical context through methods such as adding supporting geospatial fields or searching functionality. This enhancement improves the accuracy of geographical data visualization by eliminating location ambiguity.

announcements.title: Oracle Database@AWS is now available in the Canada Central and Sydney AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Oracle Database@AWS has expanded to two new AWS Regions: Canada Central and Sydney, with one Availability Zone in each region initially. This service provides access to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) managed Oracle Exadata systems located within AWS data centers. The expansion enables customers to more easily migrate their on-premises Oracle Exadata and Oracle RAC applications to a similar cloud environment.

announcements.title: DeepSeek OCR, MiniMax M2.1, and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct models are now available on SageMaker JumpStart
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the availability of three new foundation models on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: DeepSeek OCR, MiniMax M2.1, and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. These models provide specialized capabilities including document intelligence, multilingual coding, and advanced multimodal reasoning, allowing customers to build sophisticated AI applications across various use cases on AWS infrastructure.

announcements.title: Announcing memory-optimized instance bundles for Amazon Lightsail
announcements.summary: Amazon Lightsail has launched new memory-optimized instance bundles offering up to 512 GB of memory across 7 different sizes. These instances support both Linux and Windows operating systems with various pre-configured application blueprints including WordPress, Drupal, Magento, and others. The bundles are available for both IPv6-only and dual-stack networking configurations.

announcements.title: AWS STS now supports validation of select identity provider specific claims from Google, GitHub, CircleCI and OCI
announcements.summary: AWS Security Token Service (STS) now supports validation of identity provider-specific claims from Google, GitHub, CircleCI, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure for OIDC federation. This enhancement allows you to use these custom claims as condition keys in IAM role trust policies and resource control policies when using the AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity API. The feature enables more fine-grained access control for federated identities from these popular identity providers.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudFront announces mutual TLS support for origins
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudFront now supports mutual TLS authentication (mTLS) for origins, allowing customers to cryptographically verify that requests to their origin servers come only from authorized CloudFront distributions using TLS certificates. This certificate-based authentication eliminates the need for customers to manage custom security controls, providing a more secure and streamlined way to authenticate CloudFront's identity when accessing origin servers.

announcements.title: AWS announces Flexible Cost Allocation in AWS GovCloud (US)
announcements.summary: AWS Network Firewall in AWS GovCloud (US) now supports flexible cost allocation through Transit Gateway attachments, allowing organizations to automatically distribute data processing costs across multiple AWS accounts instead of consolidating all charges in the firewall owner account. Customers can create custom metering policies to allocate charges based on their specific organizational chargeback requirements. This feature helps security and network teams better manage centralized firewall costs across distributed account structures.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect now provides APIs to test and simulate voice interactions
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has launched new APIs that allow developers to programmatically test and simulate contact center voice interactions. These APIs enable configuration of test parameters such as caller information, call reasons, expected responses, and business scenarios like after-hours conditions. This feature helps validate contact center workflows and self-service voice interactions before deployment.

announcements.title: AWS HealthImaging adds JPEG XL support
announcements.summary: AWS HealthImaging now supports storing and retrieving medical images in JPEG XL format without transcoding, maintaining data fidelity while reducing storage costs. This enhancement simplifies integration with applications that require JPEG XL encoded DICOM data, particularly benefiting digital pathology and whole slide imaging systems.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS now supports IPv6 for VPC endpoints of RDS Service APIs
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS now supports IPv6 for VPC endpoints of RDS Service APIs, enabling dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6) connectivity for accessing RDS APIs directly within your VPC without internet traversal. This expands on the existing IPv6 support for public endpoints and provides an expanded address space to help scale applications beyond IPv4 limitations.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect launches improved wait time estimates
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has launched improved wait time estimates that provide more accurate metrics for queues and enqueued contacts in contact centers. This enhancement enables organizations to set better customer expectations, offer callback options during long wait times, and make more strategic decisions about workload distribution across multiple queues. The improved metrics give contact centers enhanced visibility to optimize routing choices and resource allocation.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports AWS PrivateLink
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports AWS PrivateLink, enabling customers to establish secure connectivity between their VPC and the service without data traffic traversing the public internet. This enhancement allows network administrators to onboard AWS service endpoints directly to their VPC, keeping all data transfers within the AWS network for customers requiring security beyond standard HTTPS/TLS2 protocols.

announcements.title: Amazon ECS now publishes container health status as a CloudWatch metric
announcements.summary: Amazon ECS now publishes container health status as a CloudWatch metric through Container Insights, providing enhanced observability for containerized applications. This new metric allows customers to monitor the operational health of their containers and set up CloudWatch alarms to proactively respond to unhealthy containers when health checks are configured in their ECS task definitions.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda launches enhanced observability for Kafka event source mappings
announcements.summary: AWS Lambda has launched enhanced observability features for Kafka event source mappings that provide CloudWatch Logs and metrics to monitor event polling, scaling, and processing states. This new capability helps customers quickly identify and resolve setup issues to maintain reliable data streaming workloads. The feature is available for both Amazon MSK and self-managed Apache Kafka event source mappings.

announcements.title: New Partner Revenue Measurement gives visibility into AWS service consumption
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Partner Revenue Measurement, a new capability that provides AWS Partners with visibility into how their solutions drive AWS service consumption across both partner-managed and customer-managed accounts. This tool enables partners to better understand their revenue impact and product consumption patterns by tagging AWS resources using their AWS Marketplace product codes with the tag key "aws-apn-id."

announcements.title: Amazon GameLift Streams expands streaming capability to six new regions
announcements.summary: Amazon GameLift Streams has expanded its streaming capabilities to six new regions: London, Stockholm, São Paulo, Mumbai, Seoul, and Sydney. This expansion enables customers to deliver low-latency streaming experiences to players across Europe, South America, India, and Asia while increasing overall GPU availability for better scalability.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 R8a instances are now available in Europe (Spain) and Europe (Frankfurt) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 R8a instances are now available in the Europe (Spain) and Europe (Frankfurt) regions, featuring 5th generation AMD EPYC processors with up to 4.5 GHz frequency.
